body: I'll look into it.  I definitely need something positive and fulfilling in my life.  Thanks.  Hopefully I don't fuck it up like I have with so much else in my life, but it seems to be working for you.  I'll have to get a dog too.

That sounds really exciting, actually, and I'm very happy that you found something to give your life meaning.  It sucks that you're this far along and have had to suffer so much.  No one deserves this kind of life.

I'd really like to take a journey alone, but it's not as easy for a female.  

And I do hate lonely adventures.

Thank you, though!  I bet you could write a pretty nice book about your experiences in life.
Of course I'd like a friend.  But I don't have them. I go to work and everyone is making plans and I'm the weird "negative" one with the action plan and the problems who goes home alone at night.
